meta.name: Single-VM installed, the release before the candidate
meta.description: Install the registry's latest create-lamaste — the release before the candidate, which the campaign publishes only after provisioning — as a relay has it, for the upgrade suite's Panel Update.

HOST_IP.description: Static IP of the single-VM host (auto-injected by the tier runner from ctx.vmIps[host]).

sections.label: Install the previous Lamaste release via create-lamaste

steps.label: Install the registry's latest release (the candidate is published after this tier)
steps.bash:
set -euo pipefail
# A live relay was installed while the previous release was the latest; the
# candidate is published afterwards and reached through Panel Update. The
# campaign mirrors that order: this tier runs before the candidate is on the
# registry, so `latest` is the previous release, with the libraries it was
# released with (a release before 4.7 pins nothing and would otherwise
# resolve the candidate's core).
PREVIOUS="$(npm view @lamalibre/create-lamaste dist-tags.latest)"
echo "installing ${PREVIOUS}"
npm install -g "@lamalibre/create-lamaste@${PREVIOUS}"
create-lamaste --dev --skip-harden --yes

steps.label: Patch panel.json IP to match the VM static IP
steps.bash:
set -euo pipefail
HOST_IP='{{HOST_IP}}'
if [ -n "${HOST_IP}" ]; then
  sed -i "s/\"ip\": *\"[^\"]*\"/\"ip\": \"${HOST_IP}\"/" /etc/lamalibre/lamaste/panel.json
fi

steps.label: Restart lamalibre-lamaste-serverd to pick up the patched IP
